name: softonoma-orchestrator
description: Softonoma multi-agent feature pipeline: BA/legacy analysis, prototyping, planning, parallel FE/BE/mobile/integrations implementation, QA/security/performance review, PR gate. Stack: Next.js/Vercel/Tailwind, Supabase (Postgres/RLS/Auth), Prisma, Drizzle, MongoDB/Redis, BullMQ, NestJS, FastAPI/Python, React Native/Expo; plus project onboarding for new/existing/multi-repo projects. Legacy Laravel/Vue support.
